messages:
anya: quick follow-up to the kernel-selection RFC — thinking we should split into a lightweight capability-detect layer and a separate path-planner. makes adding L4/A100/H100-specific fallbacks much cleaner.

mike: +1 on separation. curious about cold-path costs though — do we probe on every request?

anya: no, probe once per model+device session and cache result. small sync probe on session start, fallback to async probe if session already hot. cache TTL configurable.

priya: we need clear telemetry for probe outcomes (success, fail, probe_version) and device tags (hw_family, sm_mask). otherwise debugging will be painful.

ethan: agree. also need runtime flags for staged rollout. rough config sketch: ```kernel_gating:\n  probe_enabled: true\n  cache_ttl_s: 3600\n  fallback_policy: prefer_sm_compatible\n  rollout_pct: 5```

mike: L4 note: for short seq (<=32) memcopy+tiling path can actually beat tensor-core kernels that are optimized for long seq. planner should consider seq_hist distribution per model.

anya: yea — we'll extend model-profile with expected_seq_hist and let planner pick kernel based on expected token-lengths.

priya: important: deterministic fallback ordering. if a kernel fails intermittently we need monotonic downgrade steps, not flip-flop between paths. documented contract pls.

lina: rollout strategy? we should canary on Dedicated first, then host. also add an "abort_on_error" escape hatch to flip back. :thumbsup:

anya: proposed rollout: canary 5% of small models (low-customer-impact) for 48h -> collect latency/token_cost/probe_failures -> expand to 25% -> full. include automatic rollback thresholds.

runtime-bot: queued perf job: `kernel-path-refactor-probe-run` on infra-cluster-3. job: 1234. link: http://perf.internal/jobs/1234

ethan: telemetry fields to capture: ["p50_latency_ms","p95_latency_ms","token_cost_per_1k","probe_latency_ms","probe_failure_count","fallback_count","inferred_kernel_id","probe_version"]. include them in per-route dashboards.

mike: add trace/span tags: `kernel_choice`, `probe_hash`, `probe_version` so SRE can correlate regressions.

priya: also let's add a small harness for L4 microbench (seq=8,16,32; batch=1..8) to catch performance cliffs. i can PR a test suite.

anya: perfect — i'll write the RFC addendum with config examples, rollout checklist, and migration steps (bump model-profile, flush caches, enable probe flag). will tag you all tomorrow.

lina: thanks — and add a note about model pinning: customers on Dedicated should be able to pin to old planner until they opt in.

anya: good call, will add. thanks everyone! :rocket:
